sources.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.x
sources.use: Primary web application security verification baseline. Default production target: ASVS Level 2 for most applications; Level 3 for high-value/high-assurance systems.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10:2025
sources.use: Awareness and threat-prioritization input. Never use as a complete security verification standard.

sources.title: OWASP Web Security Testing Guide
sources.use: Security test planning and manual/automated verification methodology.

sources.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
sources.use: Implementation guidance for authentication, sessions, CSRF, secrets, logging, SSRF, uploads, XSS and related controls.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.use: Accessibility conformance baseline. Default target for user-facing web: WCAG 2.2 AA unless a stricter legal/product target applies.

sources.title: Accessibility Conformance Testing Rules Format 1.1
sources.use: Structure transparent automated, semi-automated and manual accessibility test rules.

sources.title: HTML Living Standard
sources.use: Semantic HTML, forms, document structure and web platform behavior.

sources.title: W3C Internationalization Resources
sources.use: Language, script, locale, bidirectional text and internationalized web design.

sources.title: Core Web Vitals
sources.use: Performance UX targets: LCP <=2.5s, INP <=200ms, CLS <=0.1 at the 75th percentile, segmented by mobile/desktop.

sources.title: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics
sources.use: HTTP methods, status semantics, safety, idempotency, representations, validators and protocol behavior.

sources.title: RFC 9111 HTTP Caching
sources.use: HTTP cache behavior, freshness, revalidation and cache controls.

sources.title: RFC 9205 Building Protocols with HTTP
sources.use: Design discipline for HTTP-based APIs and application protocols.

sources.title: RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs
sources.use: Standard machine-readable HTTP error responses; obsoletes RFC 7807.

sources.title: RFC 9700 Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security
sources.use: Current OAuth 2.0 security practices and deprecations.

sources.title: RFC 9325 Recommendations for Secure Use of TLS and DTLS
sources.use: Transport security baseline.

sources.title: RFC 6797 HTTP Strict Transport Security
sources.use: HTTPS-only enforcement via HSTS.

sources.title: Content Security Policy Level 3
sources.use: CSP design and implementation. Treat exact spec status as draft; verify browser support before relying on newer directives.

sources.title: Permissions Policy
sources.use: Restrict browser features/APIs for first- and third-party contexts. Verify compatibility.

sources.title: Referrer Policy
sources.use: Control referrer information leakage.

sources.title: OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1
sources.use: Language-agnostic HTTP API contracts. A project may pin a newer supported OAS version after explicit review.

sources.title: JSON Schema 2020-12
sources.use: JSON structure and validation contracts.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF 1.1
sources.use: Secure software development lifecycle baseline.

sources.title: NIST SSDF 1.2 / SP 800-218 Rev.1
sources.use: Track emerging changes only. Do not silently treat draft requirements as final.

sources.title: SLSA Specification 1.2
sources.use: Software supply-chain integrity, source and build track controls, provenance.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry
sources.use: Vendor-neutral traces, metrics and logs; correlation and instrumentation.

sources.title: Google Site Reliability Engineering Books
sources.use: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring, incident response, postmortems and release reliability.

sources.title: The Twelve-Factor App
sources.use: Configuration, processes, backing services, deploy parity and operational portability. Apply as guidance, not dogma.

sources.title: Google Search Central Developer Documentation
sources.use: Crawlability, indexability, structured data and technical SEO for Google Search.

sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework 1.0
sources.use: Privacy risk management, data processing inventory, lifecycle and minimization.

sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework 1.1
sources.use: Track emerging changes only; do not silently treat draft as final.

sources.title: W3C Privacy Principles
sources.use: Privacy principles for trustworthy web design.

sources.title: Playwright Test Documentation
sources.use: Resilient browser E2E testing when Playwright is selected.

sources.title: Testing Library Guiding Principles
sources.use: User-centered UI test behavior when Testing Library is selected.

sources.title: Web Application Manifest
sources.use: Installable web app metadata. Verify platform support; draft status.
